title: End of content!
description:
You've reached the end of 'intentional' content for the modpack. Thank you for playing!

There's nothing stopping you from playing more, I just haven't put a ton of effort into the content going forward.

If you want me to keep making it, please let me know in the discord! Feedback and suggestions are always welcome.

What could come next:
- Finishing of WIP abnormalities
- More abnormalities
- Expansion of the tech side of things
- Final boss/story
